topic: Food Truck Out of Cash Change

script.title: NO CASH, NO CARD
script.scene_zh: 餐車窗口 · 現金不足
script.story_hook: A hungry student meets a dead card reader.
script.intro_zh: 飢腸轆轆的學生遇到壞掉的刷卡機。
script.welcome_en: Welcome back, friends! Today a food truck runs into a money mix-up.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎回來，朋友們！今天餐車上發生一場小小的付費烏龍。
script.outro: That's today's story! Stay hungry, stay kind.
script.outro_zh: 今天的故事到這裡！保持飢餓，保持善良。
script.practice_intro_en: Let's echo this lunchtime scene, line by line.
script.practice_intro_zh: 讓我們一句一句，重現這個午餐場景。

script.youtube_title: 【🌮餐車刷不了卡怎麼辦】沒帶現金・幫忙留位怎麼說？🥤街頭人情味英文一次學✨｜Food Truck English
script.youtube_title_en: "I Need Exact Change" — When the Food Truck Card Machine Is Down
script.youtube_description:
排了半小時終於輪到你，結果刷卡機壞了、身上又沒現金？這集真實重現餐車窗口的付費小烏龍：刷卡機故障、只收恰好現金、問提款機路線、甚至先吃飯後付錢的人情信任。整段 18 句自然美式口語，附繁體中文翻譯與 IPA 標音，後半段逐句跟讀，聽完在街頭用餐再也不慌！
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱我們的頻道，每天一集，讓英文變成你的直覺！
script.youtube_description_en:
You finally reach the front of the line — and the card reader is dead, with zero cash in your pocket. This episode recreates a real food truck moment: the broken card machine, the exact change rule, asking for the nearest ATM, and even an old-school trust plan: eat now, pay later. 18 lines of natural American English with IPA and translations, plus a repeat-after-me section so you can handle any street food surprise.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🌮餐車付款英文｜刷卡機故障・恰好現金・提款機路線｜聽完就會處理小狀況｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
午餐時段排到餐車窗口，刷卡機卻剛好壞了怎麼辦？
身上沒現金，這頓飯還吃得上嗎？

這一集帶大家走進中午的餐車隊伍，跟著沒帶錢包的學生，經歷刷卡機故障、只收恰好現金、問提款機路線，最後收下一份「先吃後付」的人情。

你會聽到：
💳 付款出錯：例如「My card reader is down today.」、「I have zero cash on me.」。
🗺️ 找提款機：例如「Where's the closest ATM, do you know?」、「Two blocks east, by the corner grocery store.」。
🤝 人情與信任：例如「Come back later, pay then.」、「Everyone deserves a warm burrito, right?」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先完整聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把街頭交易的英文說得順又暖。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

願你的下一頓餐車料理，刷卡順利、人情更順利！

script.thumbnail_action: patting empty pockets in front of a food truck menu

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi! One burrito, please, extra cheese.
dialogue.zh: 嗨！請給我一個墨西哥卷餅，起司加多。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Coming right up. That'll be eight fifty.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkʌmɪŋ raɪt ʌp ðætl bi eɪt ˈfɪfti/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I just tap my card? My wallet's at home.
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ dʒʌst tæp maɪ kɑrd maɪ ˈwɑləts æt hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 我可以感應刷卡嗎？我的錢包放在家裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bad news, my card reader is down today.
dialogue.phonetic: /bæd njuːz maɪ kɑrd ˈridər ɪz daʊn təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 壞消息，我的刷卡機今天壞了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're kidding! I have zero cash on me.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr ˈkɪdɪŋ aɪ hæv ˈzɪroʊ kæʃ ɑn mi/
dialogue.zh: 不會吧！我身上沒有現金。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's okay, I need exact change anyway, sorry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˈoʊkeɪ aɪ nid ˈɛɡzækt tʃeɪndʒ ˈɛniˌweɪ ˈsɑri/
dialogue.zh: 沒事，反正我們也只收剛好金額，抱歉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you take payment apps on the phone?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju teɪk ˈpeɪmənt æps ɑn ðə foʊn/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not without the reader, wish I could help!
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt wɪˈðaʊt ðə ˈridər wɪʃ aɪ kʊd hɛlp/
dialogue.zh: 沒有讀卡機就不行，真希望幫得上忙！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm. Where's the closest ATM, do you know?
dialogue.phonetic: /hʌm wɛrz ðə ˈkloʊsɪt ˌeɪ ti ˈɛm du ju noʊ/
dialogue.zh: 嗯……最近的提款機在哪裡，你知道嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two blocks east, by the corner grocery store.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu blɑks ist baɪ ðə ˈkɔrnər ˈgroʊsəri stɔr/
dialogue.zh: 往東兩個街口，轉角那家雜貨店旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it. Can you hold my spot? I'll run fast!
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt kæn ju hoʊld maɪ spɑt aɪl rʌn fæst/
dialogue.zh: 知道了。可以幫我留位置嗎？我馬上跑回來！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell you what, come back later, pay then.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl ju wʌt kəm bæk ˈleɪtər peɪ ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 這樣吧，你待會兒回來再付錢，沒關係。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Really? You trust me with a dinner like that?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrɪli ju trʌst mi wɪð ə ˈdɪnər laɪk ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？你就這樣相信我這頓飯？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hey, everyone deserves a warm burrito, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɛ ˈɛvriˌwʌn dɪˈzɜrvz ə wɔrm bəˈritoʊ raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 嘿，每個人都值得吃頓熱的捲餅，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You've got a deal! I'm back in twenty minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊv ɡət ə dil aɪm bæk ɪn ˈtwɛnti ˈmɪnəts/
dialogue.zh: 成交！我二十分鐘就回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll keep it hot, extra cheese, no problem.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl kip ɪt hɑt ˈɛkstrə tʃiz noʊ ˈprɑbləm/
dialogue.zh: 我會幫你保溫，起司加倍，沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you so much, you just saved my lunch!
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju sɑˈmʌʧ ju dʒʌst seɪvd maɪ lʌntʃ/
dialogue.zh: 太感謝你了，你救了我的午餐！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! See you soon, kiddo. Run, lunch rush's on!
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ si ju sun ˈkɪdu rʌn lʌntʃ rʌʃz ɑn/
dialogue.zh: 哈！一下見，小朋友。快跑，午餐人潮要來了！
